chip.description: Four-voice PCM/ADPCM sample player with a 21-bit sample-ROM address bus (2 MB), a YM3012-compatible output and a YM2151-compatible digital auxiliary input, integrating four 8-bit main-CPU/sound-CPU communication ports (taxonomy §4.14 example).
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/k053260.cpp in MAME 0.288, device full name "Konami 053260 KDSC".
